definitions.explanation: The south-facing exit of a train station, building, or other public facility.

examples.japanese: {南口|みなみぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{南口|みなみぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バス{停|てい}→バス停：05295_basutei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a bus stop at the south exit of the station.

examples.japanese: {南口|みなみぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: After you go out the south exit, please turn right.

notes:
Used primarily for train stations, where exits are named by compass direction to help passengers navigate. Most major stations in Japan have named exits ({南口|みなみぐち}, ⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧, ⟦{東口|ひがしぐち}→東口：24067_higashiguchi⟧, ⟦{西口|にしぐち}→西口：21655_nishiguchi⟧), and these are essential for giving and understanding directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{南口|みなみぐち}: south exit of the station
- {南口|みなみぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out the south exit
- {南口|みなみぐち}⟦{改札|かいさつ}→改札：04120_kaisatsu⟧: south exit ticket gate
- {南口|みなみぐち}ロータリー: south exit rotary/roundabout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧: north exit
- ⟦{東口|ひがしぐち}→東口：24067_higashiguchi⟧: east exit
- ⟦{西口|にしぐち}→西口：21655_nishiguchi⟧: west exit
- ⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧: exit (general)
